messages:
elaine_support: Hey team, customer ACME running rw-7b on hosted endpoint reported p95 latency jumped ~30% and p99 ~60% after we rolled the int8 quant profile this morning. They see timeouts on long-context requests. :frowning:

ravi_ml: thanks for flagging — did we change calibration buckets or the fallback policy for that rollout?

noah_runtime: deploy-bot shows: 
```
deploy-bot: rollout complete: quant-profile=v3-int8 -> endpoint=acme-prod-rw-7b pool=cluster-prod-2
calibration_job: started
calibration_job: 2/3 shards succeeded, shard-3 timed out
```

ravi_ml: that shard timeout is suspicious. If calibration didn't finish for a shard we might be falling back per-request to fp16 during cache misses, causing expensive conversions and p99 spikes.

elaine_support: customer provided an example RPC that repros: 6k token prompt, streaming response, latency jumps ~1.2s at p95. They sent request_id=req_0xf23a.

noah_runtime: copying commands to grab traces: 
```
# get request trace
rc logs --request req_0xf23a --service inference --since 1h
# get pod and kernel stats
rc pods --endpoint acme-prod-rw-7b --metrics
```

sophie_oncall: quick mitigation: roll back quant profile to v2 (fp16 default) for that endpoint and pin it while we investigate. I've queued a rollback: `/deploy rollback acme-prod-rw-7b --to-profile v2-fp16`

deploy-bot: rollback initiated by sophie_oncall. expected downtime ~10s. :white_check_mark:

ravi_ml: for root cause, we need: endpoint config, quant profile hash, calibration logs, and a sample prompt (anonymized). Ask customer to enable debug logs (one time) and share the calibration_job id. Also need model sequence length distribution — are they sending many long tails?

elaine_support: I asked ACME for sample prompt, calibration_job id (shows as job_778), and allowed us to enable debug. They also uploaded full request timeline.

noah_runtime: initial hypothesis: calibration shard timed out so that shard falls back to per-request dynamic quant adjustment. That path reinvokes kernel conversions and extra memcpy for KV cache hits -> p95/p99 inflation. Also possible INT8 kernel path regresses on our current kernel selection for long sequences (we saw a similar perf cliff when attention tiling changed).

ravi_ml: next steps I will: 1) replay calibration_job job_778 locally on a staging cluster with identical hardware, 2) reproduce request req_0xf23a with qprofile v3 and v2 to compare latencies, 3) check model logits/quality delta for short/long prompts to ensure no silent degradation.

elaine_support: customer is ok with rollback for now, asked for ETA on a permanent fix.

noah_runtime: ETA: if it's just calibration timeout we can bump calibration timeout and re-run (few hours), otherwise we may need to tweak kernel selector heuristics (1-2 days). Short-term: keep endpoint pinned to fp16 profile and enable an automated canary that runs long-context perf tests on new quant profiles before global rollout.

ravi_ml: also adding a fallback override: if calibration incomplete -> force global fallback to fp16 at pod start instead of per-request. That avoids the costly runtime path. I'll open an RFC/PR today.

elaine_support: noted. I'll update ACME: rollback done, we're investigating, will follow up with repro timeline and ETA. :thumbsup:
